messages:
maria: Heads up — PR #15847 is ready but CI is hung on macos-integration. can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/15847
kevin: seeing a rebase conflict in serve/cache from the infra change yesterday. local run passes but CI shows 'TypeError: getCache is not a function' in logs. :confused:
jordan: @kevin can you paste the failing snippet? if it's just the import rename I can do a quick patch. don't want to touch runtime kernels before canary though.
ci-bot: macos-integration restarted (attempt 3). flaky test flagged: tests/serve/test_cache.py::test_kv_eviction — marking for retry.
sasha: ops reminded me we have a partial deploy freeze window tonight. prefer to land after the 02:00 UTC rebase window unless this is trivial. touching cache could affect canary latency.
maria: it's a tiny change — two-line fix to the import + add a small test tweak. Kevin, if you open a hotfix branch I can expedite review and approval. rebase window is at 2024-09-15T02:00Z per the release calendar.
kevin: done — branch hotfix/pr-15847-kv-fix pushed and rebased onto main (force push). CI queued: https://ci.internal/redwood/15847/hotfix
jordan: quick review now, pinging @maria for fast approval. :eyes:
maria: looked — lgtm, approving. :thumbsup: recommend canary at 2% then ramp if metrics OK.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for rev abc123 (pr-15847) to 2% traffic. health checks passing so far (latency: p95 86ms).
ops-bot: Confirmed — no global deploy freeze tonight for small runtime hotfixes. sasha to coordinate if anything changes.
sasha: Thanks — i'll watch the canary. If p95 stays within expected bounds for 30m we can promote. otherwise we'll rollback and queue for the rebase window.
kevin: thanks all. i'll keep an eye on macos CI reruns and post logs if it flares up again.
jordan: thumbs. if CI flakes again we should consider skipping macos job for a single quick revert to unblock other merges.
maria: agreed — keep the revert option ready. posting any further failures here. :white_check_mark:
